description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Plundering Barbarian, adding {C}{C}.
Plundering Barbarian dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Plundering Barbarian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Plundering Barbarian enters the battlefield, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding two mana of any color.
Repeat.
